headline: Names the Postal Service facility at 520 Carter Street in Fairview, Illinois, after Sgt. Douglas J. Riney.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building in Fairview, Illinois, as the "Sgt. Douglas J. Riney Post Office." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates. The official summary gives no further details about the rest of the law.
